usage: 水費 is a noun and refers specifically to the charge for water usage in a household or property.
You usually find 水費 mentioned on monthly bills along with other utilities like electricity and gas.
When talking about paying utilities in Cantonese, 水費 is commonly used together with 電費 (electricity bill) and 煤氣費 (gas bill).
水費 can take measure words like '張' (zoeng1) when referring to the paper bill itself, but not when talking about the expense generally.
In conversations, you can say '交水費' which means paying the water bill.
